settings.title: Settings
settings.application.appearance.heading: Appearance
settings.application.theme.title: Theme
settings.application.theme.description: Choose light, dark, or follow system.
settings.application.accent.title: Accent colour
settings.application.accent.description: Buttons, links and the selected chat.
settings.application.neutral.title: Background tone
settings.application.neutral.description: Neutral, cool or warm greys behind the text.
settings.application.language.title: Language
settings.application.language.descriptio: The language the app is shown in. Changing it reloads the page.
settings.application.streaming.title: How replies appear
settings.application.streaming.descripti: Choose how the assistant's text appears as it writes.
settings.application.paste.title: Paste text directly
settings.application.paste.description: Paste long text straight into the chat instead of attaching it as a file.
settings.application.haptics.title: Vibration
settings.application.haptics.description: Vibrate when you tap, on devices that support it.
settings.application.web_search.title: Web search on by default
settings.application.web_search.descript: New chats start with web search on. Toggling it in a chat changes only that chat.
settings.application.tool_approvals.desc: Whether the assistant may open web pages and use connectors on its own, or asks you first each time (you can allow one for the rest of a chat). You can change this for a single chat in the chat box.
settings.application.pypi.title: Let code install extra Python packages
settings.application.pypi.description_al: Lets code that runs in a chat install extra Python packages from the public PyPI website, not just the ones included here. Off by default: the code runs in your browser, so this is your call.
settings.application.task_model.title: Task model
delete_all_conversations.title: Delete all chats
delete_all_conversations.body: Delete all your chats, including the ones inside projects? This cannot be undone.
settings.location.heading: Location
settings.location.description: Share where you are so answers about weather, local time and nearby places fit. While this is on, your location is sent along with every message to the company that runs the model. Off by default.
settings.location.device_note: Uses your browser's location permission. Your position is rounded to about 1 km, read when you open a chat, and not stored on our server.
settings.location.denied: Your browser blocked location access, so nothing is shared. Allow it in your browser's site settings, then turn this on again.
settings.location.unavailable: This device could not find its location, so nothing is shared.
settings.usage.load_failed: Could not load usage. Try again.
settings.usage.billing_load_failed: Could not load billing options. Try again.
settings.usage.unavailable: Usage and billing are not available here.
settings.usage.billing_group.title: Billing group
settings.usage.billing_group.description: Which group your usage is charged to. You can only choose groups you belong to.
settings.notifications.load_failed: Could not load notification settings. Try again.
settings.notifications.not_set_up.title: Notifications are not set up here yet
settings.notifications.not_set_up.descri: Notifications need a one-time set-up by whoever runs this service. With the Cerea kit, running {#configure}./configure{/configure} creates it and {#compose}docker compose up -d{/compose} switches it on. Until then there is nothing to turn on here.
settings.notifications.this_device.title: This device
settings.notifications.this_device.off: Get a notification here when something needs you, even with the app closed.
settings.notifications.tell_me_when.desc: For all your devices. A notification is skipped while you are looking at the app.
A coding agent is waiting for your approval or an answer to a question.
settings.notifications.event.agentTurn.d: A coding agent has been working for more than a minute and a half and stopped.
settings.notifications.event.scheduleRun: A scheduled action ran to its end, or could not run.
settings.notifications.event.backgroundT: A task an agent started in the background ended with an error.
settings.notifications.event.chatTurn.la: A long chat answer is ready
settings.notifications.event.chatTurn.de: A chat reply that took more than a minute and a half finished.
settings.notifications.devices.title: Your devices
settings.notifications.devices.none: No devices yet. Turn notifications on from a browser or the installed app.

settings.notifications.notice.remove_fai: Could not remove that device. Try again.
settings.notifications.notice.generic_fa: That did not work. Try again.
settings.notifications.notice.test_faile: Could not send a test. Try again.
settings.notifications.notice.enabled: Notifications are on for this device.
settings.notifications.notice.disabled: Notifications are off for this device.
settings.notifications.notice.not_taken: The notification did not go through. Try again in a moment.
